payload.text:
Before dawn on Mon 16 Nov, Mars and Jupiter are just 1.2° apart, high in the south-east. The Leonids peak on Tue 17 Nov; the Moon sets at 23:28 that night, so look up after midnight on the nights around the peak. On Fri 20 Nov the Moon passes Saturn in the evening.

Positions computed for central Europe (50°N, 15°E) with astronomy-engine; meteor rates from the International Meteor Organization. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
